label: D2 after a common a2->S2 transition, late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (delay 2), and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2, i.e. the common a2->S2 transition. It never fires on S1 or on rare transitions, and never at D1 or GO. It is also gated by time in the episode: it is essentially silent before trial ~40 and its rate climbs steadily up to trial 99 (99% of activation mass is at ep_trial >= 50). The predicate captures nearly all activation mass, but precision is only ~0.7: many qualifying steps stay below threshold. Magnitude, from example windows, is largest when a2->S2 repeats over consecutive trials, especially after rewarded trials, and is weak right after a switch or an unrewarded trial. Most false positives are in that kind of context. Adding prev_action != 1 raised dev F1 slightly (0.82 vs 0.80); I recorded the simpler predicate. All variables are observed at D2 (action and state are known there).
